Connor / Marissa — reviewed Orbit's marked-up PDF and the pricing sheet. I drafted proposed amendment language (attached: proposed-amendment-language.docx) to walk the line between commercial flexibility and risk control for Redwood. Key points below — please confirm commercial acceptability and I'll loop Legal to produce a tracked-change Order Form.

Proposed (high level):
1) Annual Minimum Commit / True-up (Section 2.1(a))
   - Add: "Any true-up invoiced by Redwood will be limited to activity occurring within the 12 months immediately preceding the invoice date. Redwood will provide written notice of any true-up amount at least thirty (30) days prior to invoicing and will include sufficient supporting detail (usage report and line item reconciliation)."
   - Rationale: caps retroactive exposure and gives customer visibility.

2) Fee Corridor / Cap-Floor definition (Section 3)
   - Replace the asymmetric proposal with a Year-1 cap of +/-7.5% of the baseline Exhibit-A fees, calculated on an annualized basis. After Year-1, parties will renegotiate corridor parameters as part of renewal.
   - Add: "For avoidance of doubt, cap adjustments do not create a separate billing true-up outside the mechanism defined in Section 2.1(a)."

3) Onboarding carveout (footnote to Exhibit A)
   - Add footnote: "Usage recorded during the Onboarding Window (first forty-two (42) calendar days following go-live) will be excluded from baseline Minimum Commit calculations and from any true-up invoiced under Section 2.1(a)."

4) Mutual audit / reconciliation window
   - Add a 45-day mutual reconciliation period following notification of a true-up during which both parties can raise disputes. Any undisputed amounts are due per the invoice terms.

I think this preserves Redwood's ability to bill for under-commit while addressing OrbitHealth's ask for a bounded lookback and onboarding protection. If sales confirms, Legal will prepare the tracked-order form.

Attachments: proposed-amendment-language.docx (draft language), exemplar clause snippets.
